functions.does: The Power Functions L motor on the rear unit, run from the battery box behind it, works the pneumatic pump through a crank, filling the system with air.
functions.source: book: page 203 (the Power Functions and Pneumatic V2 badges; picture 1 of each pair shows the battery box switched on); the pump's build steps are inferred
functions.note: the motor (p654 99499) is the control; the axle named is its output. Unsure which parts make up the pump

functions.does: The black gear on the right of the cab turns a pneumatic valve that sends air to the two big yellow cylinders, raising and lowering the boom.
functions.source: book: page 203 (left pair: switch on the motor, turn the valve; the boom moves up and down); which side's valve works the boom is inferred
functions.note: needs air from the pump, so only works with the motor running

functions.does: The black gear on the left of the cab turns the second pneumatic valve, which works the small cylinder in the harvester head, opening and closing its two spiked gripper arms.
functions.source: book: page 203 (right pair: the gripper arms open and close), page 201 (bottom right photo); which side's valve works the gripper is inferred
functions.note: needs air from the pump, so only works with the motor running

functions.does: The cab and boom slew round on a turntable on the front unit, about 270 degrees.
functions.source: book: page 200 (top left photo, the 270 degree arrow)
functions.note: turned by hand; unsure whether a gear drives it

functions.does: The black gear on top of the rear unit, just behind the cab, steers the machine: through a pair of gears it turns the 60 tooth turntable joining the front and rear units, and a lever linkage steers the front wheels with it.
functions.source: book: page 201 (top right photo: the gear marked, the arrows on the front wheel and the bend between the units)
functions.note: unsure whether it bends the machine in the middle, steers the front wheels, or both

functions.does: The black gear on the boom's tip turns the harvester head round on its 28 tooth turntable.
functions.source: book: page 201 (bottom right photo, the arrow on the gear at the head)

functions.does: The circular saw blade under the harvester head spins freely.
functions.source: inferred: the blade sits on its own pin; the book draws no arrow on it

functions.does: All eight wheels roll freely; none is driven.
